comment: THE DEAD-EXPORT FENCE baseline. An export listed here is exported by a LIVE file but has NO live caller — and a TEST IS NEVER A CALLER. A CALLER is: a code reference in another live module; an intra-module reference (definition + >=1 real call, e.g. completeTaskPlan -> completeExecution inside actions.js); a CALL in a shipped instruction surface — the name invoked as name( or referenced as require('./x').name; or a declared export root. A BARE PROSE TOKEN (even a backtick code-span that merely NAMES the function) and COMMENTS are NOT callers — a citation is not an invocation. RATCHET: maxDead may only ever be LOWERED and entries only ever REMOVED (by wiring or deleting). RE-SEED 2026-07-19 — COUPLED MOVEMENT, NOT A CODE CHANGE: the FILE fence was tightened to the same caller rule this fence has always used (a presence-check array of path literals is no longer a call edge; a path merely NAMED in markdown prose is no longer an execution root). analyzeExports classifies exports only INSIDE LIVE FILES, so shrinking the live set mechanically moved this count: 102 -> 71. 34 entries LEFT the list because their whole FILE is now reported unreachable and a dead export inside an already-dead file is the FILE fence's business (reporting both would double-count the same defect) — every one of them is still dead, now tracked one level up in .ctoc/reachability-baseline.json. 3 entries JOINED it, and they are DEAD BY TRANSITIVITY, not new defects: src/lib/actions.js#deletePlan was credited only by src/lib/stale-cleanup.js, src/lib/inbox.js#createQuestion only by the eu-ai-act/gdpr agent runners, and src/lib/regulatory-regime.js#retentionDays only by src/lib/retention.js — every one of those creditors is itself now reported unreachable, so the credit was a dead file vouching for an export. Their host files are live; their callers are not. RE-SEED PROVENANCE (R4-C, 2026-07-14, kept): R4-B credited any identifier inside a FENCED code block, which buried 23 genuinely-reachable exports that CTOC recipes invoke with INLINE code — including approveSubplans (the Gate-3 done-all gate) — and falsely credited src/lib/ui.js#doctor via unrelated fenced tokens; call syntax replaced fenced-block membership. R6-C: src/lib/ui.js#doctor RESOLVED by DELETION.
